name: zuna
description: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted chat with a modern interface.

scripts.test: npm run test:crypto && npm run test:server && npm run test:core
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zuna/core && npm run typecheck -w @zuna/ui && npm run typecheck -w @zuna/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @zuna/web
scripts.build:ios: node scripts/build-crypto-apple.mjs && node scripts/fetch-sqlite.mjs && npm run build:core -w @zuna/ios
scripts.test:ios:all: npm test && npm run test:ios:check && npm run test:ios && npm run test:ios:sim && npm run test:ios:ui && npm run test:ios:release
